activation_rule: This artifact becomes active machine authority only through an approved BASELINE_LOCK on protected main with exact merge-SHA Hosted CI PASS.

source_basis.statement: These values close semantic gaps identified after M3 Exit. They are not represented as recovered R3.4 source facts and must not be inferred from Issue prose.

sample_profile.source_selection: Only exact immutable metric instances/observations belonging to the explicitly selected SESSION analysis_release may contribute; no current/latest release pointer is consulted.
sample_profile.m4_comparison_key_rule: M4 comparison_key_hash is recomputed from this authority's comparison-key contract using immutable release-bound facts. Existing source observation comparison_key_hash is lineage only and is not silently reinterpreted.
sample_profile.median_rule: Sort finite VALID numeric contributor values ascending; odd count selects the middle value; even count is arithmetic mean of the two middle values.
sample_profile.valid_contributor_rule: status=VALID and finite value_numeric; source observation eligibility must be ELIGIBLE.
sample_profile.reason_codes_rule: For VALID sample use []; otherwise sorted unique union of selected source reason codes plus M4_LONGITUDINAL_NO_VALID_VALUE.
sample_profile.coverage_rule: Minimum coverage across VALID contributors; if no VALID contributor, minimum coverage across selected sources.
sample_profile.confidence_rule: Minimum confidence across VALID contributors; if no VALID contributor, minimum confidence across selected sources.
sample_profile.source_episode_count_rule: Count distinct non-null episode_id values among VALID contributors.
sample_profile.source_observation_refs_rule: Sorted unique typed source observation references; exact source release_id is retained.
sample_profile.logical_content_hash_algorithm: SHA256_CANONICAL_JSON_UTF8_SORTED_KEYS_COMPACT; numeric value is represented in hash material as IEEE754_BINARY64_BIG_ENDIAN_HEX or null.

canonicalization.strings: UNICODE_NFC; no case folding; persisted semantic strings otherwise exact
canonicalization.nulls: Required nullable fields are emitted explicitly as null; omission is invalid.

objects.world_product_versions: string-keyed object; keys canonicalized by object-key rule

canonicalization.numbers: metric_semantic_version is canonical JSON integer; floating-point values are forbidden in comparison-key material

explicit_exclusions.session_id: Excluded so repeated sessions with otherwise compatible semantics can form one longitudinal series.
explicit_exclusions.context_id: Excluded; material context semantics are projected through version/profile fields instead of unique row identity.
explicit_exclusions.pilot_id: Excluded from P1 aircraft/mission-system observed trend to avoid activating P4 human assessment.

comparison_key_contract.incompatible_rule: Any material-field difference changes comparison_key_hash and segments rather than joins.

trend_status.decision_rule: For >=3 valid points, projected_change=slope*(x_last-x_first). If MAD=0, sign(slope) selects INCREASING/DECREASING and zero selects STABLE; otherwise abs(projected_change)<=MAD selects STABLE and larger signed change selects INCREASING/DECREASING.

trend_profile.point_rule: All selected samples are emitted as points in SESSION_ORDER; non-VALID samples carry null value and preserve sample_status.
trend_profile.numeric_rule: Finite IEEE-754 binary64 inputs/outputs; no NaN/Infinity; Golden comparisons use absolute tolerance 1e-12. Hash manifests use source logical hashes rather than reserialized computed floats.
trend_profile.bridge_rule: Only explicit APPROVED metric.trend_bridge rows may bridge semantic versions; bridge_hash is part of input lineage. Without an approved bridge, semantic versions segment.

trend_input_hash_contract.samples_rule: All selected trend points ordered by session_order; each item carries exact sample_id and metric.longitudinal_sample.logical_content_hash.
trend_input_hash_contract.bridge_hashes_rule: Sorted exact approved bridge_hash values actually applied; empty when no bridge is used.

release_replay_contract.exact_input_membership: registry.longitudinal_release_input contains exact input SESSION release_id + sample_id membership.
release_replay_contract.historical_query_rule: Historical longitudinal/debrief queries require explicit release_id. current/latest fallback is forbidden.
release_replay_contract.release_scope_pointer_rule: registry.release_scope_pointer may support an explicitly requested current-view discovery operation only; its result must be materialized as an exact release_id before trend/debrief query/replay.
release_replay_contract.original_as_known: Use only the exact base release and its immutable bound definitions/catalog/context/world/evidence.
release_replay_contract.retrospective: Requires an explicit retrospective_release_id; later interpretation never mutates or masquerades as the base release.
release_replay_contract.trend_bridge_rule: Only APPROVED metric.trend_bridge identities explicitly included in lineage may bridge metric semantic versions.
release_replay_contract.annotation_rule: debrief.annotation is append/revision oriented; annotation mutations never update immutable Metric/World/Release facts; mutation reason is persisted in audit.audit_log.reason.

dto_transport_rules.numeric: finite JSON number only; nullable only where contract marks ?
dto_transport_rules.structured: JSON object/array, never embedded JSON string
dto_transport_rules.exact_release: Every historical trend/debrief read contract carries explicit release identity before application execution.
dto_transport_rules.application_boundary: API and GUI consume application ports/projections; GUI persistence access and API/GUI business recomputation are forbidden.

rules: release_id is mandatory; current/latest pointer resolution is forbidden inside this query contract.
RETROSPECTIVE requires an explicit retrospective_release_id and never resolves current/latest.

fields.source: exact immutable release supplying the item

rules: SUPERSEDE and DELETE require exact target_annotation_id.
Every mutation appends a new debrief.annotation revision where applicable and an audit.audit_log row; immutable Metric/World/Release facts are never updated.
No M4 annotation_type carries score, rubric, human capability or team assessment semantics.
